response.answer: Teacher beliefs, self-efficacy, and professional development interact with school leadership and regional resources to enhance 21st-century skills in English and math. Transformational leadership and supportive resources boost teacher confidence and student learning outcomes. Effective leadership and adequate resources are crucial for successful 21CS implementation.
